contexts.text: This My memorial into generation, generation () = that (the Divine Human) is to be perpetually worshipped. A memorial = that which is to be remembered; and, when predicated of the Divine, the quality in the worship... Memorial is predicated of the quality of the Divine in worship, as to truth... That memorial = the quality of the Divine in worship. Illustrated.
Holy is predicated of truth; worship thence is signified by the memorial of his holiness ().
The day shall be to you for a memorial () = the quality of that state in worship.

And for a memorial between the eyes () = that it should be perpetually in the understanding; a memorial = perpetual remembrance. It is said a memorial, because in the Word this is predicated of the Intellectual.
That it is for a memorial. Signified.
Write this memorial in a book () = for perpetual memory. A memorial = what is to be remembered, or what is in the memory.
a. [3]. Their memorial books... have been opened...
Baptism has been instituted... for a memorial that (man) is to be regenerated. AC 10386. AR 776:3.
A memorial Appendix to all the psalmbooks.
This memorial thing shall be given...
That it be bread for a memorial () = that it be received and heard by the Lord.
